# FORE Online - Foundation for Orthopaedic Research and Education

> > Online continuing medical education platform for the Foundation for Orthopaedic Research and Education (FORE), offering post-course materials and CME/CE credits for orthopaedic and sports medicine professionals.

FORE Online provides access to post-course content from symposiums including the Detroit Regional Sports Medicine symposium and Primary Care Orthopaedics courses. The platform offers AMA PRA Category 1 Credits and continuing education certificates for physicians, athletic trainers, and physical therapists through ACCME-accredited programs.

## Key Topics

- Foundation for Orthopaedic Research and Education (FORE)
- AMA PRA Category 1 Credit
- Continuing Medical Education (CME)
- Sports Medicine
- Detroit Regional Sports Medicine Symposium
- Orthopaedics for Primary Care
- Athletic Training Continuing Education
- Physical Therapy Continuing Education
- ACCME Accreditation
- Board of Certification (BOC)
- Michigan Physical Therapy Association (MPTA)
- Post-Course Materials
- Course Evaluations
- Rehabilitation Education

## Optional

- [Detroit Sports 2018 Post Course](https://foreonline.org/detroit-2018): 2018 Detroit Sports Medicine symposium post-course materials and CME credits
- [2018 Orthopaedics for the Primary Care Practitioner Post Course](https://foreonline.org/pcp-2018): 2018 Primary Care Orthopaedics post-course with CME/CE credits
